title: TesseraQL validation rule sets v1
description: Schema for TesseraQL shared validation rule documents (rules/*.yml): named rules a route references from its 'validate:' block with 'use:'. Documented in validation-rule-sets.md.

rules.description: Named validation rules. Each declares what the rule is; how a route uses it (params:, field:, when:) stays at the reference.

rule.description: Cross-field expression. Exactly one of rule: or file:.

file.description: Validation SQL, resolved relative to this document. Exactly one of rule: or file:.

binds.description: The bind contract a reference's params: must satisfy exactly. Ambient binds (principal.*, audit.*) are supplied by the framework and never listed here.

code.description: Default stable rule code, overridable at the reference.

message.description: Default message key, overridable at the reference.
